headline: Thai Teen Rocker Makes History, Wins America's Got Talent
meta_description: 16-year-old Nene Royal from Phuket becomes the first Thai winner of America's Got Talent, taking home $1 million and inspiring her nation.
summary_short: A 16-year-old rock guitarist from Phuket has become the first Thai winner of America's Got Talent, defeating nine finalists with her heavy metal performances.
body:
Rattikarn Amloy, known as Nene Royal, has made history as the first Thai winner of America's Got Talent. The 16-year-old rocker claimed victory in the show's 21st season, defeating nine other finalists and earning a $1 million prize. Performing a rendition of The White Stripes' Seven Nation Army in California's finals, Nene's heavy metal guitar work impressed the judges and audiences worldwide. She emerged as a clear fan favourite after a viral audition video where she performed The Cranberries' Zombie, accumulating 20 million views and capturing hearts across Thailand and beyond.

Nene's journey began in her hometown of Phuket, where she learned guitar at age seven and spent years busking at Naka Weekend Market. Her victory sparked celebrations across Thailand, with her school, Kajonkiet International School, hosting viewing parties where students chanted her name. Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul congratulated her, saying she had "brought honour to Thailand" and "instilled pride in the Thai people." The Thai government highlighted what made her win truly special: a young girl from Phuket carried her Thai identity with confidence onto one of the world's biggest stages.

Thailand's connection to her victory was deeply felt even through technical challenges. Many Thai fans, unable to watch the live broadcast on NBC, followed a YouTube livestream that was abruptly cut during the results announcement—sending many into momentary distress before celebrations erupted when word spread of her win. Tour guide Piyarat Na Songkhla, who had watched Nene perform in Phuket since her childhood, expressed what many felt: "I feel so elated and happy for her. It's unbelievable that she has gone this far."
quick_facts: Nene Royal, 16, first Thai winner of America's Got Talent
Won $1 million prize in the show's 21st season
Audition video performing 'Zombie' reached 20 million views
Learned guitar at age seven in Phuket, Thailand
Performed with Linkin Park before winning finale
